name: Home Page
description: Route-level page component rendered at '/'. Imports the canonical TOOLS list (ToolDefList) from the shared data layer and derives all view-model data locally via pure projection functions. Renders three sections in strict order: (a) workflow overview paragraph, (b) quick-start table listing all 11 tools with columns [Step, Tool (as React Router Link), Description], (c) ClosedLoopDiagram SVG component arranging tools in a circular closed-loop flow. Projection utilities (toQuickStartRow, toDiagramNode) are co-located in HomePage.utils.ts and exported for independent unit testing. ClosedLoopDiagram is a separate component in src/components/ClosedLoopDiagram.tsx accepting DiagramNode[] via props, rendering a responsive SVG with viewBox="0 0 500 500", circular node layout, connecting arrows forming a closed loop, accent-colored nodes, clickable links, and accessibility attributes. Dark terminal aesthetic with cyan accents, fully responsive.

Route-level React functional component rendered at '/'. Imports TOOLS from the shared data layer, projects to QuickStartRow[] and DiagramNode[] via toQuickStartRow and toDiagramNode, and renders three sections: (a) workflow overview

functions.name: ClosedLoopDiagram
functions.description: React functional component that renders an SVG diagram arranging tool nodes in a circular closed-loop flow. SVG uses viewBox='0 0 500 500' with preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' for responsiveness. Nodes are positioned on a circle at angles computed as (step - 1) * (2π / N) - π/2. Arrows connect node[i] → node[(i+1) % N] forming a complete closed loop. Each node is rendered with its accentColor for fill/stroke and is a clickable link to '/tool/{slug}'. SVG includes role='img' and a <title> element for accessibility. Dark terminal aesthetic with cyan accent theme. Exported from src/components/ClosedLoopDiagram.tsx.

inputs.description: Ordered list of DiagramNode items to render in the circular SVG layout.

error_data.message: ClosedLoopDiagram requires at least 2 nodes to render a closed loop.
ClosedLoopDiagram requires at least 2 nodes; a single node cannot form a loop.

postconditions: Returns an <svg> element with viewBox='0 0 500 500' and preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet'

SVG contains a <title> child element with descriptive text

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function. SVG geometry is computed from input nodes with no external state or I/O.

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n = number of nodes

invariants: HomePage is rendered exclusively at the '/' route path
TOOLS contains exactly 11 ToolDef items; any change to the tool count requires contract revision
Quick-start table rows are always ordered by step number ascending (1..11)
DiagramNode angular position is deterministic: angle_rad = (step - 1) * (2 * Math.PI / N) - Math.PI / 2
The closed loop always connects node[i] → node[(i+1) % N] based on step-sorted order
toQuickStartRow and toDiagramNode are pure functions: same input always yields same output, no closures over mutable state
All tool links use React Router <Link> with pattern '/tool/{slug}' — never raw <a> tags for internal navigation
ClosedLoopDiagram SVG viewBox is fixed at '0 0 500 500'; responsive scaling is handled by preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet' and CSS width/height
ClosedLoopDiagram SVG root always carries role='img' and contains a <title> element for screen readers
HomePage and ClosedLoopDiagram source files must each remain under 300 lines; exceeding triggers extraction of QuickStartTable using the pre-defined QuickStartTableProps
No custom CSS is used; all styling is via Tailwind CSS v3 utility classes
No class components; all components are React functional components with TypeScript type annotations on exports

data_access.rationale: HomePage reads the TOOLS constant (ToolDefList) from the shared data layer, which contains PUBLIC documentation metadata: tool names, slugs, step numbers, one-line descriptions, and accent colors. This data is static, non-sensitive, and used exclusively for rendering the documentation overview. No PII, INTERNAL, or CONFIDENTIAL data is accessed. No database, API, or Convex queries are involved — all data is imported as a compile-time constant.

side_effects.rationale: Imports the TOOLS constant from the shared data layer to project into QuickStartRow[] and DiagramNode[] view models for rendering the homepage sections.
